name: Eval Dashboard lists the Security Reviewer and Compare renders the seeded prompt diff
description: From /eval, the seeded Security Reviewer card opens its eval dashboard, two seeded runs (v1 and v2) are selected and Compare shows the system-prompt diff. Read-only seeded data (no model call, no API key). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).

steps.label: navigate to the agent eval route
select the first run (custom checkbox button)
select the second run (custom checkbox button)
scroll Compare into view (it sits below the fold in the page scroll container)
added prompt word renders in the word diff
removed prompt word renders in the word diff
